source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external reference under the NumPy BSD license; no documentation text imported.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary semantics for ndarray shape, strides, reshape orders, and view-versus-copy behavior used in tensor memory accounting.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Equivalent tensor semantics in the framework used later in the curriculum; NumPy reference selected to keep Days 22-24 dependency-free.
Selected as co-primary for Day 24: the broadcasting rules page pairs with the ndarray attribute reference.
